title: A Poisonous Bird Was Found in 1989. Its Feathers Numbed a Scientist
subject: hooded pitohui

scenes.text: A scientist touched a bird, and his lips went numb.
It's the hooded pitohui from Papua New Guinea.
Its feathers and skin carry batrachotoxin, a poison once known only in poison dart frogs.
A few milligrams of its skin can kill a mouse in minutes.
The bird doesn't make the poison. It gets it from beetles it eats.
A poisonous bird. Found in 1989, not in a book.
